Fast C++ Implementation of getGFisherlam

Source: R/RcppExports.R
getGFisherlam_cpp.Rd

Computes eigenvalues needed for quadratic approximation using RcppArmadillo's optimized LAPACK routines for eigenvalue decomposition.

getGFisherlam_cpp(D, w, M, GM)

Arguments

D

Vector of degrees of freedom

w

Vector of weights

M

Correlation matrix of input Z-scores

GM

Covariance matrix from getGFisherGM

Value

List with eigenvalues (lam)

Details

This function implements Algorithm from Section 3.4 of the GFisher paper:

1. Construct M_tilde matrix using formula (13): M_tilde_ij = sign(M_ij) * sqrt(|GM_ij| / (min(d_i, d_j) * 2))

2. Ensure M_tilde is a valid correlation matrix (values <= 1, positive definite)

3. Compute weighted Cholesky: WM_chol = chol(M_tilde) * diag(sqrt(w))

4. Extract eigenvalues from WM_chol^T * WM_chol

5. For max(D) > 1, add additional eigenvalues for higher degrees of freedom

6. Filter out small eigenvalues (< 1e-10)

The C++ implementation uses Armadillo's eig_sym() which directly calls optimized LAPACK routines, providing significant speedup over R's eigen().

References

Zhang, H., & Wu, Z. (2023). The generalized Fisher's combination and accurate p-value calculation under dependence. Biometrics, 79(2), 1159-1172. See Section 3.4.
